readable.text: Hold the road and keep the clinic supplied. The medical site is under the camp's protection. Keep the armoury locked; its key stays with the officer.
readable.title: Orders for the road

items.description: A key for the locked armoury container.
items.name: Military armoury key

readable.text:
SUPPLY RECORD — COMMUNITY HEALTH SITE

Antibiotics, sampling kits and dressings were sent to the clinic. Keep the ward stocked and the pharmacy secured. The road remains under military protection.
readable.title: Clinic supply manifest

items.description: A key for the reserve safe in the officers' quarters.
items.name: HQ reserve key

readable.text: The reserve safe is locked. Its key is in the radio desk drawer downstairs. The suppressor in the safe is for the next patrol taking the north road.
readable.title: Note to the relief officer

readable.text: Thank you for playtesting Deadvox. This is the end of the authored military-camp playtest. To share feedback or reach the project home, press F9 and use Project home. You can stop here or continue playing.
